rules.body: Every command MUST declare both Short and Long descriptions in its cobra.Command definition.
Commands that return errors MUST set SilenceUsage: true and SilenceErrors: true to suppress cobra's default error printing.
Command output MUST be written via cmd.OutOrStdout() and cmd.ErrOrStderr() to support testing with captured output buffers.
MUST NOT call os.Exit outside the root command's error handler; a command returns an error and the exit code derives from it.
Long descriptions SHOULD include at least one usage example invoking the command.
